ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Evil-WinRm Execution - PowerShell Module
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects the execution of Evil-WinRM via PowerShell Module logs by leveraging the hardcoded strings inside the utility.
 Note: Unmapped fields: ContextInfo, Payload

sequences.query: (ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\wsmprovhost\\\.exe.*") OR ContextInfo = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\wsmprovhost\\\.exe.*")) AND ((Payload = RGX(".*value\\=\\"\\(get\\-location\\)\\\.path.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*value\\=\\"\\(get\\-item*\\)\\\.length.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*Invoke\\-Binary\\ .*") OR Payload = RGX(".*Donut\\-Loader\\ \\-process\\_id*\\-donutfile.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*Bypass\\-4MSI.*") OR Payload = RGX(".*IEX\\ \\(\\[System\\\.Text\\\.Encoding\\]\\:\\:ASCII\\\.GetString\\(\\[System\\\.Convert\\]\\:\\:FromBase64String\\(\\$a\\)\\)\\)\\\.replace\\(\\'???\\'\\,\\'\\'\\).*")) OR (Payload = RGX(".*\\$servicios\\ \\=\\ Get\\-ItemProperty\\ \\"registry\\:\\:HKLM\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Services\\\\\\.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*Where\\-Object\\ \\{\\$\\_\\\.imagepath\\ \\-notmatch\\ \\"system\\"\\ \\-and\\ \\$\\_\\\.imagepath\\ \\-ne\\ \\$null\\ \\}\\ \\|\\ Select\\-Object\\ pschildname\\,imagepath.*")) OR (Payload = RGX(".*\\$a\\ \\+\\=\\ \\ \\\\\\"\\$\\(\\$\\_\\\.FullName\\\.Replace\\(\\'\\\\\\'\\,\\'\\/\\'\\)\\)\\/\\\\\\"\\}else\\{\\ \\ \\$a\\ \\+\\=\\ \\\\\\"\\$\\(\\$\\_\\\.FullName\\\.Replace\\(\\'\\\\\\'\\,\\ \\'\\/\\'\\)\\)\\\\\\"\\ \\}.*") AND Payload = RGX(".*\\$a\\=\\@\\(\\)\\;\\$.*")))
